newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq extends rally on resurgent high-tech issues.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq extends rally on resurgent high-tech issues.

text.p: While the Dow Industrials closed lower amid renewed concern over rising interest rates, resurgent high-tech issues propelled the Nasdaq higher again.

Still riding the wave of Intel Corp's upbeat forecast at the start of the week, high techs raked in further gains as the Nasdaq resisted the downward pull of strong economic data, which took the steam out of blue chips.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 6.38 points, or 0.53 percent, at 1212.09, even though declining issues led advances by 2046 to 2009. Volume was about 572 million shares.

Among the techs moving higher in brisk trading was Iomega Corp, which topped the Nasdaq most active list, rising three to 17-7/8. Intel gained 1-3/8 to 97, Microsoft Corp rallied 1-1/4 to 137-3/4, and Glenayre Technologies Inc rose 2-1/4 at 22-5/8.

Among other Nasdaq gainers, Israel's Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd jumped 3-1/2 to 47 after a U.S. Food and Drug Administration panel recommended the approval of its multiple sclerosis drug Copaxone.
